title: A booking already in progress still blocks the slots its remaining time and buffer cover

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-21: readBlockingBookings reads .gte('starts_at', now), so a booking that started a minute ago is not a booked range any more. With mixed service lengths or a buffer after, the slot right after it (or inside it) is offered and accepted. Fix: read rows whose ends_at plus the after-buffer is still ahead of now.

DONE 2026-11-21: readBlockingBookings now reads confirmed and pending rows whose ends_at is after now minus the longest after-buffer (480 minutes), instead of starts_at >= now, so a session under way keeps its remaining time and its buffer; bufferConflict does the exact math. Tests in lib/spaces/booking.test.ts (an in-progress booking still blocks) cover a live 60 minute session and a just-ended one inside its after-buffer.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
